Pokémon TCG Standings Generator

Import from CSV

Header row, any column order: Player, Record (or Wins / Losses / Ties), Card 1, Card 2 (or one Deck column such as “Charizard Pidgeot”), plus optional Place, Tournament, Date, Division. Players are ordered by Place if present, otherwise by row order. Comma, semicolon and tab separators work.

#PlayerRecordCard 1 nameCard 2 name

Enter players in placement order (1st at the top). Type a Pokémon’s name (e.g. “Charizard”) and its icon is picked automatically. The two card names form each player’s deck for the pie charts. Records are optional (e.g. 5-1-1). The graphic is generated as a PNG.

To save the graphic, take a screenshot of it or use your browser’s print / save as PDF.
